title: 走进 AI Agent 第二篇：决定 AI Agent 能力上限的关键技术
content: This article explains that context engineering—what information an AI model sees and how it's organized—determines an agent's effective capability more than the model's raw intelligence. Key techniques include: managing the API message structure (system prompts, tools, conversation history); preserving KV Cache efficiency by keeping static prefixes unchanged; designing clear system prompts with structured formats and workflows; loading domain knowledge dynamically via Skills rather than all at once; injecting state summaries at the context end so models can perceive status without expensive recalculation; compressing context to combat "context rot" where information becomes unfindable; and using sub-agents to isolate bulky intermediate data from the main context.

The current translation "步行者" (meaning "walkers" or "pedestrians") differs significantly from the original English meaning. "Pacers" refers to pace horses that set the speed in harness racing, reflecting Indiana's horse-racing and automotive heritage. content: Hot Chips 2026 highlighted that AI computing bottlenecks have shifted from processing cores to data movement and memory architecture. Samsung proposed a three-phase evolution: custom HBM relocating controllers to the base die for 10–20% performance gains; advanced HBM integrating compute units for near-memory processing; and zHBM, a 3D vertical stack eliminating the 2.5D interposer, reducing DRAM power consumption ~70% and boosting bandwidth over 2.3×. For inference, high-bandwidth flash (HBF) and QLC SSDs address capacity needs cost-effectively. The trend points toward memory vendors becoming co-designers of AI platforms, with advanced packaging and domestic equipment suppliers gaining strategic value.

title: Your alt text passes automated checks. That doesn’t mean it’s any good.
content: WebAIM's 2026 report found 27% of images on popular home pages have missing, vague, or duplicated alt text. While automated tools reliably flag missing alt text, they struggle with quality assessment. GitHub developed an alt text plugin using deterministic rules for provable issues (filenames, placeholders, generic terms, repetition) and an optional AI model for contextual judgments. The tool uses layout-aware detection for repeated alt text and structured prompting to reduce false positives. Privacy protections include URL redaction and opt-in design. The authors emphasize automated checks are a floor, not conformance—human testing with assistive technology remains essential.

content: At Gamescom 2026, all five "Best Mobile Game" nominees are Chinese-developed titles: *Arknights: Endfield*, *Genshin Impact*, *Silver City*, *Where Winds Meet*, and *Zenless Zone Zero*. This complete sweep highlights China's dominant position in mobile game development. *Genshin Impact* and *Zenless Zone Zero* from HoYoverse likely have the strongest prospects given their established global track record and polished production values.

title: 通过定义一个内核接口层 OpenKAL，实现了 C++通用交叉编译/构建，可以在 Windows 上交叉编译 Linux 和 macos 程序 (其实更通用 在任意 OS 交叉构建到任意 OS 程序)
content: OpenKAL is a kernel interface layer enabling C++ cross-compilation and building across operating systems. It allows developers to compile programs for Linux, macOS, and Windows from any of those systems, providing a universal kernel abstraction. The project includes specifications, a build tool, and working examples.
